title: Rust: Finite State Machine
description: Implement a flexible finite state machine with typed states, events, and guards.

steps.title: Define State and Event Types
steps.description: Define `State` and `Event` string types. Create a `Transition` struct with From, To states and Event. Define a document workflow (draft, review, published). Print the transitions.
hints: `struct Transition { from: State, event: Event, to: State }`
Draft → submit → Review → approve → Published, reject → Draft

steps.title: FSM with Transition Table
steps.description: Create an `FSM` struct with a `current: State` and transitions stored as `HashMap<State, HashMap<Event, State>>`. Implement `send(&mut self, event: Event) -> Result<(), String>`. Print state transitions.
hints: `send` looks up current state then event.
Return error if no transition for current state + event.

verification.failureMessage: Transition from draft to review to published.

steps.title: Guard Conditions
steps.description: Add guard support: `TransitionRule { to: State, guard: Option<Box<dyn Fn() -> bool>> }`. Implement a guard that checks if the user is authorized before approving. Print when blocked.
hints: Change transition values from State to TransitionRule.
Evaluate guard before allowing the transition.
Print 'Transition blocked by guard' when guard returns false.

verification.failureMessage: Show a transition being blocked by a guard.

steps.title: Entry and Exit Actions
steps.description: Add entry and exit callbacks: `on_entry: HashMap<State, Vec<Box<dyn Fn()>>>` and `on_exit: HashMap<State, Vec<Box<dyn Fn()>>>`. Call them when entering/exiting states. Print action messages.
hints: Call exit actions of current state before transition.
Call entry actions of new state after transition.

verification.failureMessage: Send an event and print the entry/exit action messages.

steps.title: Hierarchical States
steps.description: Implement nested states. Create parent state `review` with substates `editing`, `reviewing`. Inherit parent transitions. Print the full state path (e.g., `review.editing`) after each transition.
hints: Store state as a path string like `"review.editing"`.
Parent transitions apply to all substates.
When entering parent, start in initial substate.

verification.failureMessage: Demonstrate nested states with dot-separated paths.
